name: zones_t26_map_edge_start_clamp
description: Conformance test 26 (map edge / start clamp, §7.6.1 quirk). Lot width 1, depth 3, minDepth 1, maxDepth 3; SetOptions(0, 0, 0). Road (2, 3..7); zone 4 on x 0..1, z 5 (a 2 x 1 rect at the map's x = 0 edge). ExamineBoundaries: S = {0, 100, 0, 0}, C = {1, 1, 1, 1}, D = 1, Q = 2, flag 1. The depth axis is x with a high-side D, so p0 = a2 - Ld + 1 = 1 - 3 + 1 = -1, replaced by 0 by the clamp. The full-depth override applies (Ldepth 2 <= maxDepth 3, Lrow 1 < ps + 2 Lw = 2), so n = 2. Attempt (1,5)-(2,5) f1 fails because (2,5) holds the road -> remnant (1,5)-(1,5) f1. The walk then reaches p = -2 (kept by a1 - Ld + 1 = -2 <= p <= p0 = 0): attempt (-1,5)-(0,5) f3 fails (x = -1 is outside the city) -> remnant (0,5)-(0,5) f3. Two 1 x 1 lots; without the clamp p0 would be -1 and the walk would give one (0,5)-(1,5) f1. Control: the same shape shifted 20 cells east (road (23,3..7), zone x 21..22, z 5) needs no clamp (p0 = 20 >= 0) and gives one lot (21,5)-(22,5) f1.
